title: crataegus caroliniana
intro: Crataegus caroliniana, commonly known as the Carolina hawthorn or maypop, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is native to the southeastern United States, valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental appeal. The health benefits of Crataegus caroliniana include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including cardiotonic and anti-inflammatory effects.
